name: (Melfesh Monster) Death Throes

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

text:
Trigger The Melfesh Monster dies

---
Effect The Melfesh Monster explodes in a 30-foot burst. Creatures in the area take 3d8 fire and 3d8 poison damage (DC 24 basic Reflex save save). This ability replaces Reactive Growth.
